strength_selection: Highest reference-speaker similarity among three fixed-seed new-text renders passing automatic transcript, clipping and own-reference routing checks. This is sample selection, not a general quality score.

cases.title: Warm narration
cases.note: Listen for the voice character and relaxed storytelling rhythm.
cases.reference_text: The morning sunlight filled the room. I opened the window, took a quiet breath, and smiled at the beautiful day ahead.
cases.new_text: The old bookshop stood at the end of a narrow street. Inside, every shelf held the promise of a different adventure.

source.description: An adult British English woman with a warm, clear, gently expressive voice. Natural conversational rhythm, a comfortable medium pitch, and a friendly, reassuring delivery. Clean studio speech, without music or sound effects.

cases.title: Lively dialogue
cases.note: Listen for questions, replies and changing emphasis. One voice reads both characters.
cases.reference_text: Did you leave the tickets on the table? she asked. I put them in your bag, he replied. Then we had better catch that train.
cases.new_text: You brought the map? she asked. Of course I did, he replied. Then why are we walking in circles? For a moment, neither of them said a word.

source.description: An adult American English woman with a bright, slightly husky mid-pitched voice. Animated conversational delivery, quick natural replies and clear articulation. Sound curious and amused without exaggeration. Clean studio recording, no background music or effects.

cases.title: A longer passage
cases.note: Listen for a consistent voice and clear phrasing through a sustained passage.
cases.reference_text: The ferry left the harbour just after dawn. Daniel watched the houses shrink behind him. By the time the sun reached the hills, the island was only a distant line.
cases.new_text: Rain tapped softly against the window. Daniel set his cup beside the open book and turned another page. Outside, the town was waking up. A delivery van stopped near the bakery, and someone called a greeting across the street. He had planned to leave an hour ago, but the letter on the table had changed everything. He read the final line once more, folded the paper carefully, and reached for his coat. This time, he knew exactly where he needed to go.

source.description: An older British English man with a low, rounded, gently gravelly voice. Unhurried, thoughtful storytelling with natural pauses and steady clear pronunciation. Calm and grounded, never whispered. Clean studio recording, no background music or effects.

cases.title: Factual explanation
cases.note: Listen for distinct words, numbers and steady instructional delivery.
cases.reference_text: A compass needle points towards magnetic north. When you turn the map to match it, the landmarks around you become much easier to identify.
cases.new_text: Set the timer for twenty minutes and place the tray on the middle shelf. The warm air circulates around the food, helping it cook evenly. Leave a little space between each piece so the heat can reach every side.

source.description: An adult American English man with a clear, resonant lower-pitched voice. Relaxed but lively conversational rhythm, distinct articulation, and a confident, friendly delivery. Clean studio speech, without music or sound effects.

cases.title: Questions and answers
cases.note: Listen for changes in intonation between questions and answers.
cases.reference_text: Why does the moon look larger near the horizon? Is it really closer to us? The answer has more to do with perception than distance.
cases.new_text: Is the bridge still open? Can we cross before sunset? Yes, said the guide, but we should leave now. What happens if the weather changes? Then we take the sheltered path through the trees.

source.description: A young adult man with a light, high tenor voice and a slightly nasal, forward resonance. Clear standard American English. Quick, inquisitive conversational delivery, energetic but controlled, with distinct rising questions. Sound youthful and bright, never low, gravelly or breathy. Clean studio recording, no background music or sound effects.

cases.title: Quick-start example
cases.note: The synthetic reference included in the installation guide.
cases.reference_text: I love getting lost in a good audiobook. Every story opens a new world, and a familiar voice makes the journey feel like home.
cases.new_text: Welcome to AkinVox. Today, we are trying a new voice and telling a different story.

cases.title: Expressive delivery
cases.note: Pace, breathiness and emphasis can drift.
cases.reference_text: Rain is falling outside the old library. The shelves are full of stories, and a small lamp lights the page. Another chapter is waiting to begin.
cases.new_text: The museum opens early on Saturday. Visitors can explore the new exhibition and discover how these remarkable inventions changed everyday life.

cases.title: Whisper preservation
cases.note: Whispered delivery can become normally voiced speech.
cases.reference_text: A thin layer of snow covers the garden. Beyond the glass, a robin rests on the fence. The whole morning feels still and quiet.
cases.new_text: The clock in the hallway has stopped. I can hear the soft rustle of pages as someone turns to the next chapter. Outside, the last light is fading.

source.description: An adult woman speaking American English in a very quiet, gentle whisper throughout. Breathy, unvoiced whispering, as if speaking close to the microphone beside someone who is asleep. Clear intelligible words and a calm, natural rhythm. Maintain the whisper for every sentence. No normal voiced speech, singing, music, background noise, or exaggerated mouth sounds.

cases.title: Accent preservation
cases.note: The original accent may not carry over.
cases.reference_text: I parked the car near the water, then walked down to the beach. We can meet after work and take the boat home.
cases.new_text: After work, we drove past the harbour and stopped for a walk along the water. The boat was already gone, so we bought a coffee and watched the clouds roll in.

source.description: An adult Australian man speaking with a natural General Australian English accent throughout. Authentic Australian vowel sounds and natural non-rhotic pronunciation. A deep, warm, clear voice with relaxed conversational delivery and a comfortable natural speaking pace. Clearly Australian pronunciation without an exaggerated accent or caricature. Clean studio speech, with no whispering, shouting, singing, music or sound effects.
